description: This file defines the MyGLRenderer class which implements the GLSurfaceView.Renderer interface for an OpenGL ES 1.0 rendering setup on Android. It manages rendering lifecycle methods to draw and animate a scene including a triangle and square, handling view and projection transformations.

classes.name: MyGLRenderer
classes.description: Renderer class implementing OpenGL ES drawing lifecycle, managing scene rendering, camera setup, and object rotation.

methods.name: onSurfaceCreated
methods.description: Initial setup for rendering, including background color and object instantiation.

methods.name: onDrawFrame
methods.description: Per-frame drawing logic, clearing buffers, setting camera view, and drawing objects with rotation.

methods.name: onSurfaceChanged
methods.description: Adjusts viewport and projection matrix when the surface size changes.

methods.name: getAngle
methods.description: Returns the current rotation angle of the triangle shape.

methods.name: setAngle
methods.description: Sets the rotation angle of the triangle shape.
